# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

Prices change often, so check the current price at checkout.

**Best overall for Android: Nothing Ear (3)**
- Strong ANC (SoundGuys scored it 8.2/10), plus LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging. Battery is about 5 hours per charge with ANC on. Sound is bass-heavy and call mics are muffled.
- It sits just under $150 on Amazon.
- Sources: [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best for Samsung and Android: Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro, about $134**
- It has adaptive ANC, 18 hours of total battery and an IPX7 rating. SlashGear lists it new from Samsung's official Amazon store.
- Source: [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best value: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, $149.99 list**
- It has adaptive ANC, LDAC, multipoint and a wireless-charging case. SoundGuys measured about 5 hours 42 minutes per charge with ANC on.
- Dealectric tested code AFSC20 in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22 and it took $29.99 off, for about $120. [Buy at Soundcore (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). The store's checkout has the final word on price. iTech Level says it's also often discounted to around $100 elsewhere.
- The newer Liberty 5 Pro tested better at RTINGS but lists at $169.99, over your limit.
- Sources: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-liberty-4-pro), [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**Best Sony pick: Sony WF-C710N, about $119–$128**
- It has Sony's ANC and app, and 8.5 hours of battery with ANC on. It lacks LDAC.
- What Hi-Fi? lists it at $119 at Walmart and $128 at Sweetwater and Best Buy, with buy links on the page.
- Sources: [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise), [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)

**Best for iPhone**
- **AirPods Pro 2** have the best ANC in this price range. SlashGear says renewed pairs go for just under $150 on sale, and Apple no longer sells them new. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- **AirPods 5** cost $129, or $149 with the wireless-charging case. They have an open fit, so they block less noise than sealed earbuds. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**Cheapest good option: Soundcore P31i, $59.99**
- It has adaptive ANC, multipoint and a 4.4-star average across 8,000+ Amazon reviews. The ANC isn't class-leading. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- RTINGS also names the Soundcore Space A40 as its best budget ANC pick, though poor call mic quality is a drawback. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)

**Other options:** The Google Pixel Buds 2a ($129) are a good Pixel-friendly choice. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**If you can stretch the budget:** The Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen, $299) have the best ANC that Tom's Guide and What Hi-Fi? have tested. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/earbuds/best-noise-canceling-earbuds)

If you tell me whether you have an iPhone or Android phone, I can narrow this to one pick.
